claims.claim: Seller is selling a TV console/center table together with a TV.
claims.evidence: Witness photo shows a wall-mounted flat-screen TV installed on a built-in wooden cabinet/wood panel (TV wall unit).
Witness report contains no price list or receipt; only seller’s words mention the amount.

claims.claim: It is a 'sharp deal' (implying good value/condition).
claims.evidence: Witness photo does not show condition details like screen burn-in/scratches or cabinet damage.

risks.risk: TV screen condition unknown (possible scratches, dead pixels, or burn-in).
risks.proof: A short video powering the TV on showing a bright full-screen color test pattern (red/green/blue/white) and a static image for burn-in check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as TV not confirmed working/condition unknown (worst-case: screen issues).

risks.risk: TV brand/model and screen size not readable, so value cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the TV label/model sticker and the screen size/model text (or a photo of the back panel).
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic/unknown-size TV (worst-case: smaller/older model).

risks.risk: Whether the TV is included or only the cabinet is unclear from the photo (mounted TV may or may not be part of the sale).
risks.proof: A clip showing the TV being detached/unmounted from the wall unit (or a clear statement plus photo of the TV being removed and placed separately).
risks.if_unproven: Price as cabinet/console only (worst-case: TV not included).

risks.risk: Cabinet condition unknown (dents, warping, loose shelves/hinges).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all edges, corners, shelf surfaces, and any doors/hinges (if present), plus a quick shake test video showing stability.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cabinet with possible wear/damage (worst-case: needs repair).

risks.risk: Accessories and functionality unknown (remote, power cable, HDMI/USB ports working, mounting hardware).
risks.proof: Photo/video of included accessories (remote, stand/mount parts, power cable) and a ports check (HDMI/USB) while powered on.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'no accessories/unknown ports' (worst-case: missing remote/mount hardware).

risks.risk: Transport/removal risk in Oyo: wall-mounted unit may require professional disassembly; damage risk during relocation.
risks.proof: Video showing how it is mounted and how it comes off safely (or photos of mounting points and whether it can be dismantled).
risks.if_unproven: Price as higher risk/possible extra cost for disassembly (worst-case: buyer pays for removal/repairs).

proof_requests: Send clear close-up photos of the TV brand/model sticker and screen size (front and back).
Send a short video powering the TV on with color test patterns to confirm no burn-in/dead pixels.
Confirm in writing and with a photo whether the TV is included (show TV detached from the wall unit or show it being removed).
Send close-up photos of the cabinet/wood unit: corners, shelves, any doors/hinges, and underside/mounting points.
Show included accessories: remote control, power cable, and any mounting hardware/stand parts.
Send a video showing the TV ports (HDMI/USB) working with a device connection.
response.reason: The witness confirms a TV mounted on a wooden wall unit, but key value drivers (TV brand/model, screen size, and working condition) are not readable or shown. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable; request the specific proof items above first.
